turn.content:
The PO and receipt are the only records for this PO; no earlier invoice was on PO-2026-0090. Key facts: PO orders 1 coffee machine and 19 tea boxes; the single goods receipt GR-2026-0090 shows only 11 tea boxes received and **no coffee machine**.

No earlier ledger invoices relate to this PO, so resubmission/separate-delivery causes are not in play (and they're not in the allowed cause lists anyway). The allowed causes are `short_delivery` or `unclear`. Since received quantity is genuinely below invoiced, `short_delivery` fits.
